violation_type.title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Personnel or Hospitalization (26 TAC §747.305(b)(1))
violation_type.short_title: AP Parental Communication - Injury Requires Treatment by Health Personnel or Hospitalization
violation_type.typical_finding: There was an accidental injury where a toddler climbed onto a small table and then fell onto the ground. The caregiver reported that the child appeared to be uninjured and completed an incident report but did not immediately contact and notify the parent. The parent later sought medical treatment for the child.

The director did not immediately notify the parent of an injury that required medical attention.
